reason: A DSH plugin for processing localization inputs by inspecting, extracting, masking, slicing, and losslessly reassembling text from game scripts and common document formats.

summaries.zh: 用于检查、提取、保护标签并无损组装游戏脚本及常见文档中的本地化文本。
summaries.en: Processes localization files by inspecting, extracting, protecting tags, slicing text, and losslessly reassembling game scripts and common documents.

capabilities: Reads supported text and document files
Masks tags and placeholders during extraction
Inspects file format and text metadata
Reassembles translated content into output files
